messages:
Aisha (PM): quick heads-up — trying to lock down the launch slice for next milestone. we need a firm decision on what stays in MVP vs what we push to v1 by EOD so marketing and sales can finalize messaging.
Noah (Eng): can we surface the exact list? i think the big cost items are cross-tenant routing and promptstore retention. both add ~3 sprint worth of infra work.
Aisha (PM): agreed. proposed split: MVP = core text generation + embeddings + single-tenant promptstore; v1 = multi-tenant promptstore, advanced routing, and admin console. trade-offs: v1 has better operational controls but not blocking customer pilots.
Priya (Design): for MVP we can ship a simplified admin view (read-only) to cover support flows. that saves ~2 weeks of UX polish.
Riley (QA): reminder — if we cut routing, we still need e2e on fallback behavior. QA estimate: 5 days for canary gating + regression tests.
Noah (Eng): timeline sketch: if we cut the multi-tenant work, we can land MVP in 4 sprints (including QA). if we keep it, +2 sprints and more infra ops work.
Leo (SRE): capacity note: adding routing increases peak GPU footprint. we'd need to reserve extra Dedicated slots or do soft throttling. ops cost is non-trivial.
Aisha (PM): ok can we frame a final decision matrix? preferences: (1) keep customer pilots moving, (2) minimize ops cost, (3) preserve upgrade path for v1.
Noah (Eng): decision matrix suggestion:
- Must-have (MVP): stable gen API, streaming, basic metrics, single-tenant promptstore, token billing.
- Defer to v1: multi-tenant promptstore, advanced routing policies, admin role mgmt, per-tenant quotas.
Noah (Eng): alternative smaller cut: keep routing in but ship routing in "opt-in beta" for enterprise customers only (requires canary flag + extra monitoring).
Priya (Design): opt-in beta needs a clear CTA in the console and a visible opt-in checkbox. can be minimal.
Riley (QA): beta path will still need smoke tests and an incident playbook. call that ~3 days of QA prep.
Aisha (PM): what about launch criteria? propose:
- zero P0 regressions in the last 72h
- <2% token-error rate across canaries
- onboarding docs + launch checklist complete
- support runbook and rollback steps published
Aisha (PM): if we do opt-in beta we also require a fallback policy that routes traffic to the hosted model within 5s on failure.
Leo (SRE): we can implement fallback via smart-routing rules. will need a short maintenance window and a canary configuration.
Noah (Eng): sample canary config (very rough):
```
canary: true
traffic_split: 5%->beta,95%->default
fallback: hosted_model
metrics: latency,token_errors
```
Noah (Eng): engineering + sres can implement that by next sprint if routing is limited to opt-in.
Aisha (PM): commercial ask: ACME pilot needs SSO and prompt retention >30d. SSO is ok for MVP, retention is why they wanted multi-tenant promptstore. can we promise retention for the pilot without full multi-tenant launch?
Noah (Eng): we can do tenant-scoped retention within single-tenant promptstore (only for pilot tenants). it's a manual opt-in and flagged in the admin config. implementable within MVP constraints.
Priya (Design): will add a small banner for pilot tenants explaining retention policy and manual opt-in.
Riley (QA): QA will flag the pilot-specific flows in the test matrix. estimate still within the 5 day QA budget.
Aisha (PM): decision call: let's go with MVP cut + opt-in routing beta for enterprise pilots, and expose pilot retention via manual opt-in for ACME. this buys us customer traction and keeps timelines tight.
Noah (Eng): 👍 we'll update the roadmap and PRD. I'll tag the infra tickets to Dedicated capacity planning.
Leo (SRE): I'll schedule a short maintenance window and draft the fallback runbook.
Riley (QA): will start writing smoke tests and the canary checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-04-12T18:30Z — tag: milestone/mvp-cut. :rocket:
Aisha (PM): thanks team. i'll update the milestone tracker and ping legal/secure for SSO/retention notes. if anyone sees a blocker before EOD call it out here. :eyes:
